row: 30001168 / OWR-3389-021 — Morpurgo Conjecture 1, OWR 6/2009 pp.421–422. https://doi.org/10.4171/OWR/2009/06

A finite counterexample to the weighted Yamabe heat trace comparison (v1.0.0). Full negative answer to the universal n>=3 comparison: a finite smooth normalized S3 weight (L=10000) has scaled heat trace >13/20, while the round maximum is <321/500; both maxima are attained. The qualitative argument is an assembled classical consequence of credited Ammann–Jammes geometry and standard min–max; this note records an explicit finite quantitative application with exact certificates. n>=4 and adjacent monotonicity unaddressed. Extensive OpenAI use; unrefereed, no completed external human peer review or formal proof-assistant verification. Historical priority, firstness and current openness unestablished. Four-page note and verification archive. PR #822: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/822
